bottleneck.description: One of two Western producers of semiconductor-grade hyperpure polysilicon (with Hemlock); supplies high-purity poly used at leading-edge logic and memory fabs.

dependency.key_customers: Shin-Etsu, SUMCO, GlobalWafers, Siltronic (wafer manufacturers); Intel, GlobalFoundries downstream
dependency.key_suppliers: Internal silicon metal sourcing, trichlorosilane production captive, energy (German power)

editorial.notes: Wacker is the dominant Western supplier of electronic-grade polysilicon and together with Hemlock controls roughly three-quarters of the semiconductor-grade poly market. With Chinese poly (GCL, Tongwei) primarily solar-grade and the US Section 232 investigation reinforcing Western sourcing preference, Wacker is structurally embedded in the semiconductor wafer supply chain. Capacity expansion plus shift away from solar-grade reinforces semi-criticality. HIGH rather than CRITICAL because Hemlock provides genuine alternative.
